To secure an economy of autonomous agents,
 decentralized protocols deploy verifiable computational stake. Agents must lock tokens on a cryptographic terrace to validate network states, ensuring every operational vote requires an economic sacrifice. If an attacker spins up fake identities to flood the system, each illicit node creates a localized economic echo that destabilizes its collateral. This forces the adversary off the financial ledge, where slashed stakes immediately penalize malicious replication and preserve network integrity.
